architecture_decisions: - Preserve the canonical Engineering Run state machine and all existing stage-transition authority.
work_items: - Preserve the existing durable source-lineage, worker checkpoint, selected-candidate artifact, recovery, validation, delivery and REVIEW contracts.
validations: - Production `/autonomous` invocations execute at most one protected lifecycle stage before returning authoritative server state to the client.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — Focused route/runtime tests prove one `/autonomous` invocation can persist no more than one PLAN/IMPLEMENT/BUILD/TEST/VERIFY transition under production composition.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — A coordinator with `max_steps=1` that advances VERIFY into REVIEW returns `REVIEW_REQUIRED`, allowing the existing verified delivery path to run. Equivalent existing terminal boundaries are classified before `MAX_STEPS_REACHED`.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Client tests prove `MAX_STEPS_REACHED` causes a next request only from the newly returned authoritative revision, progress state is applied between calls, terminal/human stop reasons stop chaining, and no more than eight requests occur.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Implementation-generation tests prove the production DSPy signature/adapter consumes typed acceptance/patch fields, valid structured output becomes the existing `ImplementationProposal`, and invalid typed/schema output fails through sanitized `ModelOutputValidationError` without raw output persistence.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Exact ordered acceptance coverage and downstream safe patch/candidate validation remain unchanged; malformed or semantically invalid proposals are still rejected.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Focused model-transport tests prove production hosted Gateway models receive a 60-second timeout and zero transport retries, while existing local-development behavior remains intact.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Revision conflicts, provider failures, output-validation failures, failed implementation recovery, worker checkpoint authority, source-lineage identity, delivery authority and the REVIEW ceiling retain their existing fail-closed behavior.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Protected spec validation, committed DSPy plan validation, applicable API/client tests, Bounded Autonomy, protected promotion evaluation and full exact-head PR gates pass.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — After exact-source production deployment, a real or bounded production-QA app-building run progresses beyond the previous synchronous model-routing point without a 300-second `/autonomous` timeout. The exact same user run may be resumed when principal access permits; otherwise an equivalent production-bound workload must exercise typed generation and request-to-request continuation. A synthetic unit test alone is insufficient for deployment verification.
risks: - Production `/autonomous` invocations execute at most one protected lifecycle stage before returning authoritative server state to the client.
